title: Three bright transients on 19 July 1952 found by Enrique Solano

tellings.quote: And then my colleague Enrique Solano in Spain, he discovered another such really beautiful example with three super bright beautiful stars. It's the most beautiful example of all we have. This one is from the 19th of July, 1952.

plain: On an old glass photograph of the night sky taken at the Palomar Observatory on 19 July 1952, three very bright points of light appear that are not there in other images. The astronomer Beatriz Villarroel tells Michels that her colleague, the astronomer Enrique Solano in Spain, found them, calling it "the most beautiful example of all we have." She counts such short-lived lights, which turned up before any satellites were launched, among her signs that unexplained objects may have been near the Earth.
